ev-1326a74dbff5e00c.title: Meilisearch security basics (paraphrase)
ev-1326a74dbff5e00c.text: Meilisearch can be self-hosted as a single binary. Access is protected with a master key and API keys with scoped permissions. The open-source engine documents API-key authentication; it does not document built-in SAML or OpenID Connect single sign-on. A self-hosted instance runs on a single node, which is a limitation for high availability.
